scope: Observed attempts in this wave; counts refer to attempts, not distinct root causes.

attempts.resolution: Changed synthetic owner controls to supported Ctrl+digit PS/2 input and reran.
Sorted frame sequence identifiers and reverified captures.
Added the missing Python import and rebuilt receipts.
Both retries completed; the watchdog was subsequently changed to use a joinable native worker.
One diagnostic reached the return from main; the precise underlying cause remains unproven.
The matched SDK lacked that helper symbol; the tested implementation uses the available joinable pthread API.
An alternative debug probe using direct writes passed 4 of 4; instrumentation changes behavior, so these probes do not prove the underlying cause.

limitations: No claim that every possible exit race is eliminated.
Raw logs remain in the local audit directory and are not part of this export.
